verdict.rationale: SumUp's own docs list Reader SDKs as one of three in-person integration paths. They state these SDKs embed payment acceptance directly in Android or iOS apps, controlling a reader over Bluetooth or using Tap to Pay, and the SDK section also documents offline transactions. missing for 10: SDK-level detail (installation, API reference, code samples for iOS/Android), independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile SDKs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed in-person payments into my own iOS or Android app with official mobile SDKs

citations.quote: There are three ways to integrate SumUp in-person payments: | | Cloud API | Reader SDKs | Payment Switch |
Embed payment acceptance directly in your Android or iOS app. Your app controls the reader over Bluetooth or uses Tap to Pay.
Offline Transactions let merchants continue accepting card payments when internet connectivity is unavailable or unreliable.
